tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Page background of every screen. The default ground for text.

tokens.name: surface-soft
tokens.usage: Product tiles, cards, input wells and secondary circle buttons. Flat, no border, no shadow.

tokens.name: surface-pressed
tokens.usage: Pressed state of anything on `surface-soft`; hairline dividers inside lists.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text on `surface` and `surface-soft` (17:1). Also the fill of primary buttons and the floating nav.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text (unit, brand, timestamps) on `surface` (6.3:1) and `surface-soft` (5.7:1).

tokens.name: line-strong
tokens.usage: Borders that must be seen: text field outline, unselected radio ring. 3.4:1 on `surface`, 3.1:1 on `surface-soft`. Never for text.

tokens.name: on-ink
tokens.usage: Text and icons on `ink` fills (18.9:1).

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: The one brand hue. Add-to-cart circle, selected chip, focus ring, links. 6.2:1 on `surface`; text on it uses `on-accent`.

tokens.name: on-accent
tokens.usage: Text and icons on `accent` (6.2:1).

tokens.name: accent-soft
tokens.usage: Tint behind `accent` text: selected chip ground, 'in cart' tile ring. `accent` on it reads 5.3:1.

tokens.name: success
tokens.usage: Paid / received / matched. Text on `surface` and `success-soft` (5.4:1); fill under `on-ink` (6.1:1). Always paired with a check icon.

tokens.name: success-soft
tokens.usage: Ground for success badges and the 'Đã nhận' confirmation banner.

tokens.name: warning
tokens.usage: Flagged items: manual price, price below cost. Text on `warning-soft` (5.1:1). Always paired with an alert icon.

tokens.name: warning-soft
tokens.usage: Ground for warning badges and the 'below cost' banner.

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: Remove, void, negative cash difference. Text on `danger-soft` (4.7:1); fill under `on-ink` (5.5:1). Always paired with a word, never colour alone.

tokens.name: danger-soft
tokens.usage: Ground for the remove action behind a swiped cart line.

tokens.name: camera-bg
tokens.usage: Camera and scan screens only. Full-bleed behind the viewfinder.

tokens.name: camera-ink
tokens.usage: Text and icons on `camera-bg`.

tokens.name: camera-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary labels on `camera-bg` ('Lịch sử', hints). 7.6:1.

tokens.name: camera-ring
tokens.usage: Gold ring around the shutter button on `camera-bg` (9.3:1). Only on the camera screen.

tokens.name: scrim
tokens.usage: Dims the screen behind a bottom sheet.

styles.name: total
styles.usage: The running total and the pay screen amount. One per screen.

styles.name: price
styles.usage: Price on a match card and on a product tile in elder mode. PRD minimum for prices.

styles.name: title
styles.usage: Screen title, top-left, once per screen.

styles.name: heading
styles.usage: Section heading inside a screen; sheet titles.

styles.name: body
styles.usage: Default text. PRD minimum: nothing a seller must read is smaller.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Button labels, product names on tiles, chip text.

styles.name: caption
styles.usage: Non-essential meta only (unit, time, who sold). Never a price or an action.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Gap between a price and its unit.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Gap inside a tile between photo and text.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Gap between grid tiles and between stacked buttons.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Screen side gutter; card padding.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Between sections of a screen.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Above the total on the pay screen; around the shutter.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Cart line thumbnails, keypad wells, small inputs.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Product photo wells inside a tile, the VietQR frame.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Cards and product tiles, the camera viewfinder.

tokens.name: radius-xl
tokens.usage: Top corners of bottom sheets.

tokens.name: radius-full
tokens.usage: Every button, chip, stepper and the nav bar. Buttons are circles or pills, never rectangles.

tokens.name: tap-min
tokens.usage: Minimum height and width of anything tappable (PRD: 56dp). Circle icon buttons, chips, stepper keys.

tokens.name: tap-lg
tokens.usage: Primary pill buttons and the floating nav bar height.

tokens.name: tap-xl
tokens.usage: Elder mode buttons; the pay methods on the pay screen.

tokens.name: shutter
tokens.usage: Camera shutter diameter.

tokens.name: icon
tokens.usage: Icon size inside every button. Stroke 2.25px.

tokens.name: shadow-float
tokens.usage: Only for things that float over content: bottom nav, total bar, add circle on a tile.

tokens.name: shadow-sheet
tokens.usage: Bottom sheets.
